name: Collection O 30 Amega Crown Sub
detail: An apartment that also functions as a hotel. A spacious lobby, and also one floor with a food court. The prices of the food are friendly. The distance to the room is a bit far from the lobby, and there is a guide printed on paper from the hotel. The room is clean, the bed is clean, the bathroom is clean, the towels are yellowing (worthy of being replaced). There is liquid soap, but I'm not sure about using it. My suggestion is to bring your own toiletries. One glass bottle of drinking water is provided. Complete facilities: garden, children's play area, swimming pool, basketball court, and gym. Paid parking, motorcycle 4k and car 9k. To avoid overnight parking fees, don't forget to ask for a stamp at the lobby.

name: Townhouse Oak Hotel Niaga Surabaya
detail: In my opinion, the quality is even better than the price. Not noisy Clean They provide soap even though they don’t provide towels Close to the old town and the port. Parking is outside but it feels safe.

name: Flagship 3688 Pot Art
detail: So when the room was opened, many small cockroaches ran around. The sheets and blankets are yellow. The air conditioner seems never to have been cleaned. The walls have a lot of spider webs. But overall, in terms of quality, it is actually worth it. There's an elevator, 24-hour reception, there's a galley for mineral water, the bathroom is safe, the air conditioner is still cool, the mattress is big and soft, the TV works (although there are only 2 channels that can be watched). So if you just need a place to transit for a day or two, it's still okay. But if it's already a week for playing or business, it's better to look for something else.

name: Swiss-Belinn Airport Surabaya
detail: Every time I go to Juanda Airport, I always stay here. The staff is friendly. The room is comfortable, the bathroom is clean, the air conditioning is cool, and the WiFi is stable, with a cold mini fridge. The pool is sufficient for playing with children. A shuttle bus to the airport is available starting at 5:00 AM, so you need to book quickly because seats are limited.

name: Four Points by Sheraton Surabaya, Tunjungan Plaza
detail: In my opinion, the Four Points by Sheraton Tunjungan Plaza is a truly comfortable and practical hotel, especially because of its location directly connected to Tunjungan Plaza. It feels great to stay here because everything is easy to access, whether it's for dining, shopping, or just taking a leisurely walk. The rooms feel clean, modern, and the bed is very comfortable for resting. The service is also delightful—staff are friendly, quick, and make guests feel attended to. The atmosphere of the hotel is calm even though it's in the city center, so you can still rest maximally. Overall, I think this hotel is suitable for staycations, business trips, or vacations. The stay experience is satisfying, and I feel like I want to come back again when I visit Surabaya.

name: Swiss Belinn Tunjungan
detail: Location in the center of Surabaya, right in the middle. Just cross over to Mall TP. The hotel is always busy, and the staff are very friendly. They can help send items via JNE. Breakfast is free with popcorn and ice cream. Every time I go to Surabaya, I always stay here. Favorite hotel. Thank you, Swiss Bell Tunjungan.

name: Four Points by Sheraton Surabaya, Pakuwon Indah
detail: We are very happy to stay at the Four Points Hotel Surabaya, a strategic location, friendly staff, a varied breakfast, and very comfortable and clean rooms, but for the room I booked for 3 people with twin beds, we were given a room with 1 bed, so it was not enough for three of us. If we go to Surabaya again, we will return to this hotel.

name: DoubleTree by Hilton Surabaya
detail: My stay at DoubleTree by Hilton Surabaya exceeded all expectations. From the moment I arrived, I was welcomed with genuine warmth and professionalism by the entire team, making me feel valued throughout my stay. The room was spotless, spacious, and beautifully designed, with a very comfortable bed that ensured a restful night's sleep. Every detail was thoughtfully prepared, creating a relaxing and luxurious atmosphere. The breakfast buffet offered an impressive variety of local and international dishes, all fresh and delicious. The staff at the restaurant were attentive, friendly, and always ready to help with a smile. What truly sets this hotel apart is its exceptional service. Every team member went above and beyond to ensure guests had a memorable experience. I highly recommend DoubleTree by Hilton Surabaya to anyone visiting the city, whether for business or leisure. I look forward to staying here again in the future!

name: Whiz Luxe Hotel Spazio Surabaya
detail: I’m not sure if it’s newly built, but both the room and the lobby feel clean and new. It was nice and tidy. The city view was also good. There are plenty of places to eat just a 5-minute walk to the Loop, so I was very satisfied with the location. However, the swimming pool was too small and narrow, which made me feel that it is indeed a city hotel. Fortunately, swimming was not the main purpose of my stay. I went with a 10-year-old child, and we were able to sleep on the long sofa in the room. Breakfast is additionally charged at 124,000 Rupiah.

name: Hotel Kampi Tunjungan - Surabaya
detail: This hotel is very nice, close to the city center, allowing us to have a good sleep after a tiring volcano tour. After waking up, there are many restaurants and large shopping malls within a 10-minute walk, making the location very convenient. The next morning, it was very easy to catch a ride to the airport, which took about 30-40 minutes. The room is not very large, but it is very comfortable; if you need a hairdryer, just inform the front desk in advance, and it will be delivered directly to your room. During our stay, when we ran out of tissues, we called the front desk, and they quickly brought some to our room. The service attitude was excellent. It is worth mentioning the breakfast, which is super abundant! Highly recommended, with great value for money!
